ownership_rule: The project owns this database; no application owns it or its table. The S-Story skeleton reaches it only through the one intermediary of the project database (qnc.module.db-broker), whose table module qnc.module.skeleton-db owns it.

rules.versions: Every send from the script of Media Assist Audio is a new version, numbered 1, 2, ...; a number is never given again. This table holds only the list of versions.
rules.stories: Each version is a story of its own, a copy of the Story with no lead-in and lead-out, in story-draft-<n>.db beside project.db, written through the same story module (qnc.module.program-db). Its segments are SubClips until they are sent to the Story.
rules.record: Apart from the script (MA Audio sends to it) and the Story (it sends to the Story): the safe copy a broken Story is sent again from.
